{
  "dataset_name": "credit_g",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "credit_amount_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Scale-normalized credit_amount using the training-fold mean and standard deviation, clipped to the observed training-fold numeric span.",
      "value_range": [
        -1.12,
        4.18
      ],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_numeric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents raw currency magnitude from dominating distance calculations while preserving relative loan size.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((credit_amount - 3555.1766666666667) / 2975.2419059278004, -1.12, 4.18)"
    },
    {
      "name": "duration_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Scale-normalized duration using the training-fold mean and standard deviation, clipped to the observed training-fold numeric span.",
      "value_range": [
        -1.38,
        2.86
      ],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_numeric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives KNN a duration coordinate on a comparable scale to other numeric features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((duration - 22.206666666666667) / 13.251061173438986, -1.38, 2.86)"
    },
    {
      "name": "amount_per_month_log_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Scaled log of credit_amount per month, using duration as the repayment horizon and clipping to a training-fold plausible span.",
      "value_range": [
        -2.25,
        2.2
      ],
      "feature_family": "rate_normalized_numeric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a monthly intensity coordinate so neighbors can align by repayment scale rather than total amount alone.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.log1p(credit_amount / np.maximum(duration, 1.0)) - 5.0) / 1.5, -2.25, 2.20)"
    },
    {
      "name": "payment_pressure_log_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Scaled log of monthly amount multiplied by installment_commitment, clipped to a training-fold plausible span.",
      "value_range": [
        -2.43,
        2.05
      ],
      "feature_family": "burden_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines repayment intensity and installment share into a bounded coordinate that improves neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.log1p((credit_amount / np.maximum(duration, 1.0)) * installment_commitment) - 6.0) / 1.8, -2.43, 2.05)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Scale-normalized age using the training-fold mean and standard deviation, clipped to the observed training-fold numeric span.",
      "value_range": [
        -1.4,
        2.94
      ],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_numeric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Keeps age differences on a distance scale comparable with other numeric coordinates.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((age - 35.46666666666667) / 11.088232000138206, -1.40, 2.94)"
    },
    {
      "name": "obligation_load_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average z-score of installment_commitment, existing_credits, and num_dependents, clipped to the observed training-fold composite span.",
      "value_range": [
        -0.95,
        2.61
      ],
      "feature_family": "burden_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a compact obligation-load coordinate so KNN can place rows with similar repayment commitments closer together.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(((installment_commitment - 2.8766666666666665) / 1.1553306405046517 + (existing_credits - 1.4166666666666667) / 0.5624845676895401 + (num_dependents - 1.1666666666666667) / 0.37267799624996495) / 3.0, -0.95, 2.61)"
    },
    {
      "name": "central_numeric_l1_distance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average absolute z-distance from the training-fold numeric centroid across duration, credit_amount, installment_commitment, residence_since, age, existing_credits, and num_dependents.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        2.86
      ],
      "feature_family": "unsupervised_prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a generic prototype-distance coordinate that helps KNN distinguish typical numeric profiles from unusual ones.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
